ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 35% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central contiguous low-intensity region. High-intensity bands are localized along the leading edges of both lobes, containing numerous discrete low-intensity circular clusters. A prominent vertical high-intensity streak is located on the interior margin of the right lobe near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 72 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to visible lobe area.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple circular low-intensity pixel clusters (averaging 4-10 pixels in diameter) distributed within the high-intensity leading edge margins of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized circular pigmentation voids on the leading edges; irregular serrated profile visible on the segments of the trailing edge not obscured by water.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetric high-contrast 'leopard' mottling pattern localized exclusively to the anterior margins of the fluke lobes.
